meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把一份多智能体任务图(DAG)定义存成 JSON 文件,之后按名字直接重新运行,不必每次粘贴定义;加载时自动填充占位符并轮换运行 key。
howto.when: 当你想保存一个 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或反复调度同一张多智能体图时触发。

say.text: 把当前的这张 DAG 存成 nightly-audit
say.note: 写入 $HOME/.omo/dags 并试跑一次确认
默认加时间戳后缀,得到一次全新运行

say.text: 用 suffix 20260818 再跑一次 nightly-audit
say.note: key 固定,可复用上一次的结果

howto.what_en: Saves a multi-agent DAG definition as a named JSON file and re-runs it by name later, instead of pasting the definition each time. On load it fills placeholders and rotates the run key.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

say_en.text: Save the current DAG as nightly-audit
say_en.note: Writes <name>.json to $HOME/.omo/dags and runs it once
Defaults to a fresh rotated key
